title: You Think Memory Drives What You Love, Yet Invisible Flashes Shape Your Heart
description:
You think you must remember something to start liking it! Yet tiny flashes win your heart without any memory! This is the true story of Robert Zajonc's exposure test. Here is what went wrong with old folk wisdom.
